problem.title: Built to solve the chaos of disconnected construction data
problem.subtitle: Construction projects fail when critical information gets trapped in spreadsheets, email threads, and paper logs.

scattered.title: Scattered Information
scattered.description: Projects, contracts, milestones, and financial records fragmented across disconnected tools, isolated spreadsheets, and desktop folders.

visibility.title: Weak Visibility
visibility.description: Executives and project managers struggle to obtain a real-time, consolidated view of true progress, net financial positions, and looming deadlines.

followup.title: Manual Follow-up
followup.description: Crucial approvals, payment certificates, milestone signoffs, and expiry reminders are easily missed when dependent on manual human tracking.

problem.closing: Our goal: build a connected project-management experience where project data drives workflows, calculations, and notifications automatically.

identity.title: What is Buildora?
identity.lead: Buildora is a model-driven construction project management platform built on the Microsoft Power Platform ecosystem.
identity.paragraph: The environment acts as the company boundary, and Microsoft Dataverse is the system of record — giving each client construction enterprise its own secure, enterprise-grade workspace.
identity.highlight: Project management engineered specifically for construction contractors, consultants, and developers.

points.boundary: Isolated corporate tenant boundary for full data sovereignty and governance.
points.record: Microsoft Dataverse as the single source of truth for all relational project data.
points.security: Native Microsoft Entra ID authentication and role-based field-level security.

services.title: Comprehensive Capabilities Across Every Stage
services.subtitle: Modular yet unified architecture designed to mirror actual construction business workflows.

setup.title: Project Setup
setup.description: Project, Contract, Milestones, and Team — get every job organized with structured metadata and governance from day one.

delivery.title: Delivery Tracking
delivery.description: Chapters, progress percentages, site logs, and risk tracking, recalculated automatically as physical work is completed on site.

finance.title: Finance & Cash Flow
finance.description: Payment Certificates, Invoices, and Payments — track certified work all the way to cash collected, calculated live in real time.

documents.title: Document Management
documents.description: Project drawings, specs, and contract files stored securely in Microsoft SharePoint, automatically categorized and indexed.

insights.title: Real-Time Insights
insights.description: Live interactive dashboards, rollups, and formula-driven fields delivering instantaneous visibility into project health and margins.

alerts.title: Automated Alerts
alerts.description: Automated due-date, warranty expiry, contract milestone, and status-change email notifications — nothing falls through the cracks.

journey.title: How Buildora Works
journey.subtitle: An end-to-end connected lifecycle from contract award to final payment.

steps.title: Create Project
steps.desc: Initialize project profile, classification, client details, and initial budget.

steps.title: Add Contract
steps.desc: Establish contract value, terms, retentions, and scope of work.

steps.title: Define Milestones
steps.desc: Break down deliverables into structured chapters and scheduled milestones.

steps.title: Assign Team
steps.desc: Allocate Project Managers, Site Engineers, and subcontractors with tailored permissions.

steps.title: Track Progress
steps.desc: Log site progress updates, photo evidence, and risk logs in real time.

steps.title: Certify Work
steps.desc: Issue official Payment Certificates reflecting certified progress quantities.

steps.title: Invoice
steps.desc: Generate billed invoice amounts tied directly to verified certificates.

steps.title: Record Payment
steps.desc: Log incoming cash receipts and outgoing vendor disbursements.

journey.caption: At each stage, Buildora updates the data, applies business rules, and triggers the relevant automation.

finance.title: Complete Traceability from Milestone to Cash
finance.subtitle: No more guesswork. Live financial metrics link certified site progress straight to cash flow.
finance.formula: Net Cash Position = Total Collected − Total Outgoing
finance.metricSub: Calculated live across every active project with zero manual tallying.

tech.title: Built on Trusted Microsoft Technology
tech.subtitle: Leveraging world-class enterprise cloud services with no fragile custom backends.

items.name: Power Apps

items.name: Microsoft Dataverse

items.name: Power Automate

items.name: SharePoint

items.name: C# Plugins & Webhooks
items.desc: Synchronous high-integrity transactional calculations and business constraints.

security.title: Role-Based Governance at Enterprise Scale
security.subtitle: Security is enforced at the Microsoft Identity and Dataverse layer — not custom, untested authentication.

admin.title: Buildora Admin
admin.description: System configuration, tenant-wide settings, user provisioning, global financial rollups, and audit logging.

pm.title: Project Manager
pm.description: Complete management of assigned projects, milestones, budget allocations, risk mitigations, and certificate approvals.

engineer.title: Site Engineer
engineer.description: Daily site logs, progress percentage submissions, snag lists, site photo uploads, and field report documentation.
